intent: Turn heterogeneous skill repositories into a deduplicated, provenance-bound cold atlas and a small set of independently reviewable production proposals without executing or activating upstream material.
successCondition: Every acquired origin and source body is pinned; exact duplicates resolve to one canonical body identity; inspected mechanisms record overlap, exclusions, risks and qualification; no upstream code or skill is activated.
negativeTriggers: install or activate every discovered skill
claim semantic novelty from byte uniqueness
certify runtime quality from repository metadata
failureModes: repository origin or commit cannot be verified
source body hash changes during export
license boundary is absent or contradictory
review summary is generated without a real read
activation or external effects occur during intake
